stories.title: Chinese PV Industry Brief: China hits 1.33 TW of cumulative solar capacity
stories.description: In other news, Jiangsu province has unveiled its 2027 renewable energy auction framework, Trina Solar plans to increase its stake in Trina Storage, and China Huaneng has started construction of a 400 MW offshore solar project, while TrendForce has reported further declines in wafer and cell prices.

stories.title: EU restrictions on inverters could cut European solar deployment by up to 6%, says Wood Mackenzie
stories.description: Wood Mackenzie expects EU funding restrictions on projects using inverters from high-risk suppliers to reduce cumulative solar and energy storage installations across the bloc by 3% between 2027 and 2030. Limited local product availability, rising costs, and supply chain constraints are among the main challenges.

stories.description: Ford enters the World Endurance Championship in 2027 with the new prototype.

stories.title: Google search alternative Kagi launches Gmail rival
stories.description: The pitch is an unusual combination of privacy promises and AI features.

stories.title: Grand Theft Auto VI proves why efficiency isn’t a virtue
stories.description: On the same day that Anthropic entered the public market, a painstakingly human video game became one of most successful entertainment launches of all time.

stories.title: Nvidia hits pause on chip shipments to Southeast Asia
stories.description: Nvidia has told manufacturing partners to pause server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia as the U.S. tightens its push to keep AI chips out of China.

stories.title: Faisal Islam: Why Trump's new tariffs are less of a threat
stories.description: Other countries have rerouted trade in response to his first tariff salvo, now they are looking beyond Trump's tenure.

stories.title: The food bank helping pet owners with rising bills
stories.description: RSPCA hands out food, vet vouchers, cat litter and toys to pet owners struggling with bills.

stories.description: arXiv:2610.41183v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: LLM-guided program evolution can produce mathematical constructions, but validity, generality, and reproducibility require distinct evidence.

stories.title: Scientists discover signs of a hidden extinction crisis deep beneath the ocean
stories.description: The deep sea has long been considered a safe haven for marine life, but new genetic research suggests a hidden biodiversity crisis may be unfolding far beneath the waves. Scientists analyzing more than a decade of genetic data from five species of deep-sea fish and shrimp in the Gulf discovered troubling signs of extinction risk in every species examined.

stories.title: Greenhushing, PV prices, battery prices and the shifting bottleneck
stories.description: Greenhushing reflects a shift towards prioritising environmental performance over public sustainability commitments, as declining solar PV and battery costs strengthen the economic case for corporate decarbonisation.

stories.title: For decades, scientists may have misunderstood how brain cells work
stories.description: A major new study challenges a long-standing assumption about how the brain works, revealing that most neurons are versatile multitaskers rather than highly specialized workers.
